en-US.title: Travel Quick Convert
en-US.subtitle: Travel Unit Converter
en-US.description:
Travel Quick Convert keeps everyday unit conversions close at hand when you are traveling, cooking, shopping, or comparing measurements across countries.

Convert common measurements quickly:
- Temperature, including freezing, boiling, and oven presets
- Distance, speed, weight, volume, and area
- Cooking measurements for cups, tablespoons, teaspoons, fluid ounces, and milliliters
- Clothing size reference charts for international shopping

The app is designed for quick checks without an account, setup, or complicated menus. Choose a category, enter a value, and switch conversions from a clear dropdown when more options are available.
en-US.releaseNotes: Initial App Store release with quick unit conversions, clothing size charts, light and dark themes, and clear conversion dropdowns.
en-US.promoText: Fast unit conversions for travel, cooking, shopping, and everyday measurements.

review.notes: No account or login is required. Open the app, choose a conversion category, enter a value, and select another conversion from the dropdown when available. The app displays AdMob banner ads.
